questions.stem:
Under Regulation 6(1) of the SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018, which of the following are among the eligibility conditions for a main-board IPO?

1. Net tangible assets of at least ₹3 crore in each of the preceding three full years, of which not more than 50% is held in monetary assets
2. An average operating profit of at least ₹15 crore during the preceding three years, with operating profit in each of those years
3. A net worth of at least ₹5 crore in each of the preceding three full years

Select the correct answer.

steps: Reg 6(1)(a): NTA ≥ ₹3 crore in each of the preceding 3 full years (restated, consolidated), not more than 50% in monetary assets (cap relaxed if the IPO is entirely an offer for sale).
Reg 6(1)(b): average operating profit ≥ ₹15 crore over the preceding 3 years, with operating profit in each year.
Reg 6(1)(c): net worth ≥ ₹1 crore in each of the preceding 3 years — so statement 3 overstates it.
explanation.formula_used: Reg 6(1): NTA ₹3 cr / Op. profit avg ₹15 cr / Net worth ₹1 cr
explanation.trap: The ₹1 crore net-worth floor is often inflated to ₹5 crore or confused with the ₹3 crore NTA figure.

source_refs.note: SEBI (ICDR) Regulations, 2018 — Reg 6(1)

options.label: A

options.error: wrongly rejects statement 2: operating-profit test is ₹15 crore average with profit in each year
options.label: C

options.error: wrongly accepts statement 3: the net-worth test is ₹1 crore in each of three years, not ₹5 crore
options.label: D

questions.stem:
Suvarna Polymers Ltd plans a main-board IPO. Monetary assets were below 20% of NTA in every year.

| Year (restated, consolidated) | Net tangible assets (₹ cr) | Operating profit (₹ cr) | Net worth (₹ cr) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| FY-3 | 3.4 | 14.2 | 9.5 |
| FY-2 | 3.85 | 16.8 | 12.1 |
| FY-1 | 2.9 | 15.6 | 14.0 |

steps: NTA: FY-1 = ₹2.9 crore < ₹3 crore → NTA test fails (must hold in EACH of 3 years; average ₹3.38 crore is irrelevant).
Operating profit: average = (14.2 + 16.8 + 15.6) ÷ 3 = ₹15.53 crore, positive each year → passes.
Failing any limb of 6(1) pushes the issuer to 6(2): book building with ≥75% of net offer to QIBs, ≤15% NII, ≤10% retail.
